arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, requests, re, os, sys
path='/home/user/Desktop/Professor_Contact.xlsx'
df=pd.read_excel(path)
for idx,row in df.iterrows():
    url=row['Website']
    if pd.isna(url):
        continue
    try:
        r=requests.get(url,timeout=10)
        text=r.text
        email=re.search(r'\b[\w.%+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\b',text)
        if email:
            df.at[idx,'Email']=email.group(0)
    except Exception as e:
        pass
print(df)
# save
df.to_excel(path,index=False)
PY
